```html
CUBE ANIMALS

 General description

The aim of our mod is to enhance the Minecraft experience with regard to animals. It adds 24+ new species. We aim to maintain a vanilla-friendly style in terms of models, textures, and animations. However, this does not mean it is boring — the mod combines interesting mechanics with high visual quality. It is still under development, so new animals will be added over time.

 

List of animals

Our mob list includes various species adapted to different climates. It features mammals, birds, reptiles, and fish. The full list is included below:

  • Antelope
  • Barn Owl
  • Black Bear
  • Capuchin Monkey
  • Chameleon (26.1+)
  • Cricket (26.1+)
  • Crocodile
  • Eagle
  • Elephant (26.1+)
  • European Bison
  • Fennec
  • Komodo Dragon
  • Marmot
  • Moose
  • Mouse (26.1+)
  • Piranha
  • Rattlesnake
  • Reindeer
  • Roe Deer
  • Shark
  • Snail
  • Snow Leopard
  • Tiger
  • Toucan
  • Walrus

Mechanics

Our animals are divided into three categories: passive, neutral, and aggressive. Passive mobs are friendly and will not attack under any circumstances. Neutral mobs will not attack unless provoked, but will seek revenge if harmed. Aggressive mobs will try to hunt you down.

To fight these terrifying creatures, we provide a new weapon: the Sleep Arrow. It can be used to temporarily neutralize certain mobs. It can be bought from the Hunter or crafted using poisons obtained from our mobs. Another useful item is Animal Transporter, which allows you to take tamed and sleeping animals with you. It can be bought from the Hunter or found in certain structures.

More than one-third of our animals can be tamed and provide unique mechanics, such as powerful charging, intelligent external inventories, and even enchanting books, among others.

The mechanics of all animals, items, and the Hunter are described in the Zoological Guide, which you receive at the beginning of the game. It can also be found in some structures and bought from the Hunter.

 

 Compatibility

Our mod is compatible with Biomes O' Plenty (not required to play).

Cube Animals require Fabric API.

 

  Translations

  • English (official)
  • Polish (official)
  • Turkish (provided by community)

 

 Buy me a coffe

If you enjoy our mod you can support its development. We appreciate every donate that helps us provide updates.


buymeacoffee.com/cubedirection

 Final words

Thank you for reading this short summary. We encourage you to check out all the screenshots in gallery. If you want to ask questions, share ideas, add translation, or post your screenshots, please join our Discord community. Don't forget about our social media accounts. We are currently struggling to find free sounds for our animals, so if you would like to share your own recordings, we would be very grateful. Regarding AI we inform that none of the graphics, animations, screenshots or textures were made by generative AI.

Authors: xUszaty & SupRK

```
